send('uci')

send('setoption name Threads value 2'); send('setoption name Hash value 256')
send('isready')

send('go movetime '+str(t*1000)+ (' searchmoves '+' '.join(sys.argv[2:]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else ''))
last=''
for line in f:
 if line.startswith('info depth'): last=line.strip()
 if line.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(last);print(line.strip()); break
send('quit')
